data.description:
`push_with_progress` calls `require_no_active_leases` (src/replication.rs:100,
guard at :456), so an active lease blocks publishing local events as well as
importing remote ones. Push does not need that guard.

Push copies immutable event JSON files into the publish worktree and commits
them (`copy_files_into_worktree`, src/replication.rs:201). Event paths are
`events/YYYY/MM/DD/{uuidv7}-{event_type}.json`
(`relative_path_for_event`, src/events/mod.rs:284), so two machines cannot
produce the same path with different bytes and the `SyncError::FileConflict`
branch is unreachable in practice. Every event being pushed is already durable
in the local store; publishing it while a lease is open exports no state the
local store does not already hold, and it gives other machines visibility into
in-flight work rather than hiding it.

The concurrency hazard the lease guard exists for is entirely on the pull side,
where `IncrementalApplier` upserts remote index events into `knot_hot` and can
move a knot out from under an agent mid-action. That side is handled by the
per-knot pull filter knot.

Scope:
- Drop `require_no_active_leases` from `push` / `push_with_progress`.
- Keep the guard on `pull` / `pull_with_progress` until the per-knot filter
  lands, so this knot is independently shippable.
- `sync_or_defer_with_progress` (src/replication.rs:278) should push first and
  only report `Deferred` for the pull half, so an agent-busy machine still
  publishes. Extend `SyncOutcome` so a deferred sync can still report its push
  summary, and update `deferred_sync_detail` in src/bin/kno_mcp/sync_loop.rs to
  match.
- Update docs/leases.md, which currently states that sync push/pull is blocked
  while a lease is active (lines 11, 42-43).

Out of scope: pull-side filtering, lease ownership.
